scene_detail: 英国网购用户从2015年的200万猛增到2020年的800万，翻了四倍
template_en: There was a dramatic/sharp increase/rise in [主语], from XX to XX between [时间1] and [时间2].
template_cn: [主语]出现了剧烈/急剧的增长/上升，从XX上升到XX（在[时间1]到[时间2]之间）。
example_en: There was a dramatic increase in online shoppers in the UK, from 2 million to 8 million between 2015 and 2020, representing a fourfold rise.
note: 形容词可替换: dramatic/sharp/significant/steady/slight; 倍数表达: a twofold/threefold/fourfold rise; tripling/quadrupling

scene_detail: 某城市的网购用户数在2015-2020年间从50万暴增到300万，涨了6倍
template_en: [主语] soared/surged dramatically to reach/hit [最终数字] by [时间].
template_cn: [主语]急剧飙升/猛增，到[时间]达到了[最终数字]。
example_en: The number of online shoppers in the city soared dramatically to reach 3 million by 2020, a sixfold increase from 500,000.
subject_hint: The number of online shoppers in the city

scene_detail: 该大学的国际学生人数从2010年的1200人明显增长到2015年的5000人
template_en: [主语] rose/climbed significantly to reach [数字] by [时间].
template_cn: [主语]显著上升/攀升，到[时间]达到了[数字]。
example_en: The number of international students at the university climbed significantly to reach 5,000 by 2015.
subject_hint: The number of international students at the university

scene_detail: 澳大利亚失业率在十年间从5%一路稳步爬升到12%，没有大起大落
template_en: [主语] increased steadily/grew gradually over the period.
template_cn: [主语]在该时期内稳步增长/逐渐上升。
example_en: Australia's unemployment rate increased steadily from 5% to 12% over the decade.

scene_detail: 该地区犯罪率在最后一年只是微微上涨了一点，从22%到23%
template_en: [主语] edged up slightly to [数字] in [时间].
template_cn: [主语]在[时间]微微上升到[数字]。
example_en: The crime rate in the region edged up slightly to 23% in the final year.
subject_hint: The crime rate in the region

scene_detail: 某品牌手机销量从2015年的80万台暴跌到2020年的20万台
template_en: [主语] plummeted from [数字] to [数字] between [时间1] and [时间2].
template_cn: [主语]从[数字]暴跌到[数字]（在[时间1]到[时间2]之间）。
example_en: The brand's mobile phone sales plummeted from 800,000 to 200,000 units between 2015 and 2020.

scene_detail: 报纸阅读率从60%大幅跌落到35%，降了将近一半
template_en: The figure dropped/fell significantly from [数字] to [数字].
template_cn: 该数据从[数字]大幅下降/跌落到[数字]。
example_en: The newspaper readership rate dropped significantly from 60% to 35%, nearly halving over the period.
note: 减半表达: nearly halving; falling by almost half; cut in half

scene_detail: 德国的失业率在十年间从10%缓慢而持续地降到了6%
template_en: [主语] declined steadily/gradually from [数字] to [数字] over the [时间段].
template_cn: [主语]在[时间段]内从[数字]稳步/逐渐下降到[数字]。
example_en: Germany's unemployment rate declined steadily from 10% to 6% over the decade.

scene_detail: 最后一年通胀率只是小幅回落，从25%降到23%，几乎没变
template_en: The rate dipped slightly from [数字] to [数字] in the final year.
template_cn: 该比率在最后一年从[数字]小幅回落到[数字]。
example_en: The inflation rate dipped slightly from 25% to 23% in the final year, barely changing at all.
note: 几乎没变: barely changing; remaining virtually unchanged

scene_detail: 石油价格在整个时期内一直在20美元和35美元之间反复震荡
template_en: The rate fluctuated between XX and XX throughout the period.
template_cn: 该比率在整个时期内在XX和XX之间波动。
example_en: Oil prices fluctuated between $20 and $35 throughout the period.

scene_detail: 2015年之后，地铁日客流量一直稳定在50万人次左右不再变化
template_en: The figure remained stable at around XX for the rest of the period.
template_cn: 该数据在剩余时期内保持稳定，维持在XX左右。
example_en: After 2015, the daily subway ridership remained stable at around 500,000 for the rest of the period.

scene_detail: 电动车销量在经历快速增长后，2015年起稳定在500台不再涨了
template_en: After [时间], [主语] levelled off at XX.
template_cn: [时间]之后，[主语]趋于平稳，稳定在XX。
example_en: After 2015, electric car sales levelled off at 500 units.

scene_detail: 旅游人数在2018年达到历史最高的900万人次
template_en: [主语] reached/hit a peak of XX in [年份].
template_cn: [主语]在[年份]达到了XX的峰值/最高点。
example_en: The number of tourists reached a peak of 9 million in 2018.

scene_detail: 出生率在2012年跌到了最低谷，只有5‰
template_en: The rate bottomed out at XX in [年份].
template_cn: 该比率在[年份]降到了XX的最低点。
example_en: The birth rate bottomed out at 5‰ in 2012.

scene_detail: 房价先涨到2015年的峰值80万，然后急转直下跌到2020年的40万
template_en: [主语] rose to a peak of XX in [年份], before declining sharply to XX by [年份].
template_cn: [主语]上升到[年份]的峰值XX，随后急剧下降到[年份]的XX。
example_en: House prices rose to a peak of 800,000 in 2015, before declining sharply to 400,000 by 2020.

scene_detail: 就业率先跌到2010年的谷底10%，随后触底反弹恢复到25%
template_en: The rate fell to a low of XX in [年份], after which it recovered to XX.
template_cn: 该比率在[年份]跌至XX的低点，此后回升到XX。
example_en: The employment rate fell to a low of 10% in 2010, after which it recovered to 25%.

scene_detail: 在家庭支出中，食物开销高居榜首，占了总支出的35%
template_en: A was the most dominant item, accounting for XX%.
template_cn: A是最突出的项目，占了XX%。
example_en: Food was the most dominant item in household spending, accounting for 35%.
note: 替换: registered the highest percentage / topped the list

scene_detail: 住房排在第二位占25%，紧随其后的是交通占15%
template_en: B ranked second with XX%, followed by C at XX%.
template_cn: B以XX%排名第二，紧随其后的是C，占XX%。
example_en: Housing ranked second with 25%, followed by transport at 15%.

scene_detail: 娱乐消费在所有类别中垫底，仅仅占了5%
template_en: E was the least significant, making up merely XX%.
template_cn: E是最不起眼的，仅占XX%。
example_en: Entertainment was the least significant category, making up merely 5%.

scene_detail: 食品支出远高于服装支出，分别是35%和8%，差距悬殊
template_en: A was significantly higher than B (XX% vs. XX%).
template_cn: A明显高于B（XX%对XX%）。
example_en: Food spending was significantly higher than clothing spending (35% vs. 8%).

scene_detail: 食品开销大约是交通费用的两倍，30%对15%
template_en: A was approximately twice/three times as high as B.
template_cn: A大约是B的两倍/三倍。
example_en: Spending on food was approximately twice as high as that on transport, at 30% and 15% respectively.
subject_hint: Spending on food; that on transport

scene_detail: 2019年，日本和韩国的互联网普及率几乎一样，分别是92%和91%
template_en: E and F were roughly equal, both at around XX%.
template_cn: E和F大致相当，都在XX%左右。
example_en: In 2019, Japan and South Korea's internet penetration rates were roughly equal, both at around 91%.

scene_detail: 日本和韩国的城市化趋势走势几乎一模一样，都在40%左右
template_en: X and Y followed a broadly similar pattern, both recording around XX%.
template_cn: X和Y呈现出大致相似的趋势，都记录了约XX%。
example_en: Japan and South Korea followed a broadly similar urbanisation pattern, both recording around 40%.

scene_detail: 2020年中国的太阳能发电量远远超过印度，分别是250GW和40GW
template_en: X significantly outstripped Y, at XX% compared to only XX%.
template_cn: X远远超过Y，为XX%，而Y仅为XX%。
example_en: In 2020, China's solar power capacity significantly outstripped India's, at 250 GW compared to only 40 GW.

scene_detail: 发达国家的人均碳排放量和发展中国家之间存在巨大鸿沟
template_en: There was a striking disparity between X and Y.
template_cn: X和Y之间存在显著的差异。
example_en: There was a striking disparity in per capita carbon emissions between developed and developing nations.

scene_detail: 在全部家庭开支中，食品占了35%这一具体比例
template_en: A accounted for XX% of the total.
template_cn: A占总数的XX%。
example_en: Food accounted for 35% of total household expenditure.

scene_detail: 住房以42%的比例成为最大的一块开支，一项就快占一半了
template_en: A made up the largest share at XX%.
template_cn: A以XX%的比例占据了最大份额。
example_en: Housing made up the largest share of household spending at 42%, accounting for nearly half of the total.

scene_detail: 食品和住房加在一起超过了70%，两项占了大头
template_en: A and B combined accounted for over XX%.
template_cn: A和B合计占了超过XX%。
example_en: Food and housing combined accounted for over 70% of household expenditure.

scene_detail: 剩下的30%由交通、娱乐和服装三项平分
template_en: The remaining XX% was shared among C, D and E.
template_cn: 剩余的XX%由C、D和E分摊。
example_en: The remaining 30% was shared among transport, entertainment and clothing.

scene_detail: 写概述时发现：整个时期里A始终排名第一，E一直垫底
template_en: Overall, A was consistently the highest, while E remained the lowest throughout.
template_cn: 总体来看，A始终是最高的，而E在整个时期内一直是最低的。
example_en: Overall, food expenditure was consistently the highest, while entertainment remained the lowest throughout the period.

scene_detail: 写概述时发现：A和B总体在上升，而C和D总体在下降
template_en: Overall, A and B showed upward trends, whereas C and D experienced declines.
template_cn: 总体来看，A和B呈上升趋势，而C和D则经历了下降。
example_en: Overall, spending on food and housing showed upward trends, whereas transport and entertainment experienced declines.
subject_hint: spending on food and housing; transport and entertainment

scene_detail: 写概述时发现：A一开始最高，但到最后被B反超了
template_en: Overall, while A initially dominated, it was overtaken by B by the end of the period.
template_cn: 总体来看，虽然A最初占主导地位，但到期末被B反超了。
example_en: Overall, while food expenditure initially dominated, it was overtaken by housing costs by the end of the period.

scene_detail: 写概述时发现：各类别之间差距巨大，A一枝独秀远超其他项
template_en: Overall, there were considerable variations among the categories, with A significantly outstripping the others.
template_cn: 总体来看，各类别之间差异显著，其中A远远超过其他项。
example_en: Overall, there were considerable variations among the spending categories, with food significantly outstripping the others.

scene_detail: 两张地图分别展示小镇在1980年和2020年的样子，需要写开头
template_en: The two maps illustrate the changes that [地名] has undergone between [年份1] and [年份2].
template_cn: 这两张地图展示了[地名]在[年份1]到[年份2]之间经历的变化。
example_en: The two maps illustrate the changes that the small town has undergone between 1980 and 2020.

scene_detail: 一张是村庄现状，另一张是政府的改造规划图，需要写开头
template_en: The maps compare the current layout of [地名] with proposed plans for its redevelopment.
template_cn: 这些地图将[地名]的现有布局与其改造规划进行了对比。
example_en: The maps compare the current layout of the village with the government's proposed plans for its redevelopment.

scene_detail: 拿到一道地图题，不确定用哪种开头，需要一个百搭句型
template_en: The given maps depict how [地名] has been transformed/redeveloped over a [X]-year period.
template_cn: 所给地图描绘了[地名]在[X]年间如何被改造/重新开发的。
example_en: The given maps depict how the town has been transformed over a 40-year period.

scene_cn: 地图题概述-经历巨大变化
scene_detail: 对比两张图后发现这个地方变化翻天覆地，需要概括最大变化
template_en: Overall, [地名] has undergone significant redevelopment. The most noticeable change is that [最大变化], while [次要变化].
template_cn: 总体来看，[地名]经历了重大的改造。最显著的变化是[最大变化]，同时[次要变化]。
example_en: Overall, the town has undergone significant redevelopment. The most noticeable change is that the farmland has been replaced by housing estates, while the town centre has been considerably modernised.
note: 可替换: experienced dramatic transformation / been considerably modernised

scene_detail: 地图显示原来的农田区域现在整片变成了商业区
template_en: The once [旧特征] area has been transformed into a [新特征] zone.
template_cn: 曾经的[旧特征]区域已被改造成[新特征]区。
example_en: The once farmland area has been transformed into a commercial zone.

scene_detail: 原来的大片农田消失了，全都变成了住宅楼
template_en: [旧事物] has/have given way to [新事物].
template_cn: [旧事物]已经让位于[新事物]。
example_en: The farmlands have given way to residential buildings.

scene_detail: 原来沿着Oak街的一排老房子被拆了，取而代之的是一个购物中心
template_en: The [旧物] that formerly [位置描述] has been demolished and replaced by [新物].
template_cn: 原来[位置描述]的[旧物]已被拆除，取而代之的是[新物]。
example_en: The row of houses that formerly lined Oak Street has been demolished and replaced by a shopping centre.

scene_detail: 镇子南边原来是空旷农田，现在那里新建了一个停车场
template_en: A new [新物] has been constructed/built [方位], where [旧物/旧状态] previously existed.
template_cn: 一个新的[新物]被建造在[方位]，那里以前是[旧物/旧状态]。
example_en: A new car park has been constructed to the south of the town, where open farmland previously existed.
subject_hint: to the south of the town

scene_detail: 医院向东边大幅扩建了一栋新楼，面积几乎翻倍
template_en: The [原物] has been significantly extended/expanded to the [方向].
template_cn: [原物]向[方向]进行了大幅扩建/扩展。
example_en: The hospital has been significantly extended to the east, nearly doubling in size.

scene_detail: 中央公园被大幅缩小，现在只剩北边角落一小块绿地
template_en: The [原物] has been reduced in size, now occupying only [描述].
template_cn: [原物]的面积被缩小了，现在只占据[描述]。
example_en: The central park has been reduced in size, now occupying only a small green area in the northern corner.

scene_detail: 公交站从镇中心搬到了郊区，离居民区更远了
template_en: The [原物] has been relocated from [旧位置] to [新位置].
template_cn: [原物]从[旧位置]搬迁到了[新位置]。
example_en: The bus station has been relocated from the town centre to the outskirts.

scene_detail: 河对面的旧工厂被改造成了一栋公寓楼，功能完全变了
template_en: The old [旧物] [方位描述] has been converted/transformed into [新物].
template_cn: [方位描述]的旧[旧物]已被改建/改造成[新物]。
example_en: The old factory opposite the river has been converted into an apartment complex.

scene_cn: 新增基础设施连接两地
scene_detail: 河上新修了一座桥，把北岸和南岸连了起来
template_en: A new [设施] has been built/installed, connecting/linking [A] and [B].
template_cn: 一座新的[设施]被修建/安装，连接了[A]和[B]。
example_en: A new bridge has been built over the river, connecting the northern and southern banks.

scene_detail: 镇中心的那座老教堂前后两张图都没有任何变化
template_en: The [事物], however, remains unchanged/in its original position.
template_cn: 然而，[事物]保持不变/仍在原来的位置。
example_en: The old church, however, remains unchanged in the centre of the town.

scene_detail: 图书馆外观被翻新了一遍，但还是当图书馆用，功能没变
template_en: The [原物] has been renovated/modernised, though it retains its original function.
template_cn: [原物]已被翻新/现代化改造，但保留了原有功能。
example_en: The library has been modernised, though it retains its original function.

scene_detail: 开始描述地图变化，先从西边/北边/左侧区域说起
template_en: Looking first at the [western/northern/left-hand] section, ...
template_cn: 首先看[西边/北边/左侧]区域，……
example_en: Looking first at the western section, several notable changes can be observed.

scene_detail: 描述完一侧后，转向地图东边/南边/对面区域继续写
template_en: Turning to the [eastern/southern/opposite] side, ...
template_cn: 转向[东边/南边/对面]一侧，……
example_en: Turning to the eastern side, the changes are equally significant.

scene_detail: 原来菜市场的位置上现在建了一座现代购物中心
template_en: Where [A] once stood, [B] now occupies the site.
template_cn: 在[A]曾经所在的地方，现在是[B]占据了该位置。
example_en: Where the old market once stood, a modern shopping mall now occupies the site.
subject_hint: the old market; a modern shopping mall

scene_detail: 巧克力制作有八个步骤，从采摘可可豆到成品巧克力，需要概述
template_en: Overall, the process involves [数字] main stages, beginning with [初始阶段] and culminating in [最终结果].
template_cn: 总体来看，该流程包含[数字]个主要阶段，从[初始阶段]开始，最终以[最终结果]结束。
example_en: Overall, the process involves eight main stages, beginning with the harvesting of cocoa beans and culminating in the production of chocolate bars.

scene_detail: 水循环图里最后蒸发的水又回到降雨阶段，形成闭环
template_en: The process is cyclical, with the final stage feeding back into [某阶段].
template_cn: 该流程是循环的，最后一个阶段会回到[某阶段]重新开始。
example_en: The process is cyclical, with the final stage of evaporation feeding back into the rainfall stage.

scene_detail: 造纸流程到漂白阶段后分成两条线，一条做白纸一条做牛皮纸
template_en: Notably, the process diverges into two separate paths at [某阶段].
template_cn: 值得注意的是，该流程在[某阶段]分成了两条不同的路径。
example_en: Notably, the process diverges into two separate paths at the bleaching stage, producing either white paper or kraft paper.
subject_hint: the bleaching stage; white paper; kraft paper

scene_detail: 巧克力的制作从农民在热带地区采摘可可豆开始
template_en: The process begins when.../In the first stage,.../Initially,...
template_cn: 该流程开始于……/在第一个阶段，……/最初，……
example_en: The process begins when farmers harvest cocoa beans in tropical regions.

scene_detail: 可可豆采摘完后，接下来要进行发酵和晒干处理
template_en: Following this,.../After that,.../The next step involves.../Once this is done,...
template_cn: 接下来，……/在此之后，……/下一步涉及……/完成此步后，……
example_en: Following this, the cocoa beans are fermented and then dried in the sun.

scene_detail: 流程走到中间环节了，可可粉在此阶段被送入研磨机
template_en: Subsequently,.../At this point,.../The [材料] is/are then [动词过去分词].../Thereafter,...
template_cn: 随后，……/在这一步，……/[材料]接着被[动词过去分词]……/此后，……
example_en: At this point, the cocoa powder is fed into a grinding machine.

scene_detail: 巧克力最终被浇入模具冷却成型，整个流程结束
template_en: In the final stage,.../Finally,.../The process concludes when.../Lastly,...
template_cn: 在最后一个阶段，……/最终，……/该流程在……时结束。/最后，……
example_en: In the final stage, the chocolate is poured into moulds and left to cool and solidify.

scene_detail: 混合物被放进大烤炉里加热到200°C，需要用被动语态描述
template_en: [物质/材料] is/are + 过去分词 + (方式/地点/目的).
template_cn: [物质/材料]被+动词+（方式/地点/目的）。
example_en: The mixture is heated to 200°C in a large oven.

scene_detail: 冷却完成之后，固体材料被切割成统一大小的方块
template_en: Once/After + [前一步], [物质] is/are + 过去分词.
template_cn: 一旦/在[前一步]之后，[物质]被+动词。
example_en: Once cooled, the solid material is cut into uniform blocks.

scene_detail: 研磨产生了细粉末，这些粉末随后被转移到储存容器中
template_en: This results in/produces + [结果], which is/are then + 过去分词.
template_cn: 这会产生[结果]，然后[结果]被+动词。
example_en: The grinding process produces a fine powder, which is then transferred to a storage container.
subject_hint: The grinding process; a fine powder; a storage container

scene_detail: 到了分拣环节，流程分成两路：一路去清洗，一路去回收
template_en: At this stage, the process splits into two paths: one involves [动作A], while the other involves [动作B].
template_cn: 在这个阶段，流程分成两条路径：一条涉及[动作A]，另一条涉及[动作B]。
example_en: At the sorting stage, the process splits into two paths: one involves cleaning the materials, while the other involves recycling them.

scene_detail: 废水处理完后又被送回过滤阶段重新循环使用
template_en: ...after which the process returns to [某阶段], and the cycle repeats.
template_cn: ……之后流程回到[某阶段]，循环重复。
example_en: The treated wastewater is then sent back to the filtration stage, and the cycle repeats.

scene_detail: 文章开头需要引出一个有争议的话题，比如'大学是否应该免费'
template_en: In recent years, there has been growing debate over whether...
template_cn: 近年来，关于是否……的争论日益增多。
example_en: In recent years, there has been growing debate over whether university education should be free of charge.
note: 替换: It is often argued that... / [话题] has become an increasingly pressing issue

scene_detail: 需要在开头摆出正反双方的立场，比如科技对教育是利是弊
template_en: While some believe that..., others contend that...
template_cn: 虽然有些人认为……，但另一些人主张……
example_en: While some believe that technology enhances the quality of education, others contend that it creates more problems than it solves.

scene_detail: 遇到'你是否同意'的题目，需要在开头明确亮出自己的立场
template_en: I am firmly/largely of the opinion that...
template_cn: 我坚定地/基本上认为……
example_en: I am firmly of the opinion that university education should be made free for all students.

scene_detail: 遇到'讨论双方观点并给出你的看法'，需要表态更倾向哪一方
template_en: Although both perspectives have merit, I am more inclined to the view that...
template_cn: 尽管两种观点都有道理，但我更倾向于认为……
example_en: Although both perspectives have merit, I am more inclined to the view that the benefits of technology in education outweigh its drawbacks.

scene_detail: 遇到'利大于弊还是弊大于利'的题目，需要明确说出权衡结果
template_en: I would argue that the benefits/drawbacks considerably outweigh the drawbacks/benefits.
template_cn: 我认为其利/弊远远大于弊/利。
example_en: I would argue that the benefits of free university education considerably outweigh the drawbacks.

scene_detail: 主体段开头需要提出一个核心原因，比如'年轻人失业的首要原因是…'
template_en: The primary/principal reason for this is that...
template_cn: 其首要/主要原因是……
example_en: The primary reason for youth unemployment is the mismatch between academic qualifications and the demands of the job market.

scene_detail: 需要论述远程办公的一个关键好处，比如节省通勤时间
template_en: One significant/compelling advantage of [X] is that...
template_cn: [X]的一个显著/有力的优点是……
example_en: One significant advantage of remote working is that employees can save considerable time on commuting.

scene_detail: 需要指出社交媒体带来的最严重问题，比如青少年心理健康
template_en: Perhaps the most serious problem arising from this trend is...
template_cn: 这一趋势带来的最严重问题或许是……
example_en: Perhaps the most serious problem arising from the widespread use of social media is its negative impact on teenagers' mental health.

scene_detail: 讨论完环境问题后，需要给出一个可行的解决办法
template_en: One practical/effective measure to address this issue would be to...
template_cn: 解决这一问题的一个切实/有效的措施是……
example_en: One practical measure to address environmental pollution would be to impose stricter regulations on industrial emissions.

scene_detail: 上一句说了一个观点，现在需要解释'为什么会这样'
template_en: This is primarily/largely because...
template_cn: 这主要/很大程度上是因为……
example_en: This is primarily because many young graduates lack the practical skills that employers require.
note: 替换: The underlying reason is that...

scene_detail: 前面分析了原因，现在要说'因此导致了什么后果'
template_en: As a result,.../This inevitably leads to...
template_cn: 因此，……/这不可避免地导致了……
example_en: As a result, an increasing number of young people are struggling to find stable employment.

scene_detail: 需要把抽象观点落地，解释'在实际生活中这意味着什么'
template_en: What this means in practice is that...
template_cn: 这在实际中意味着……
example_en: What this means in practice is that students who graduate without work experience often face months of unsuccessful job searching.

scene_detail: 论述完观点后，需要举个具体例子来证明，比如某个国家的政策
template_en: A clear example of this can be seen in...
template_cn: 一个明显的例子可以在……中看到。
example_en: A clear example of this can be seen in Germany, where the government provides free university tuition to both domestic and international students.
note: 替换: For instance, in countries such as...

scene_detail: 需要引用权威研究来增强说服力，比如'哈佛大学的研究表明…'
template_en: Research conducted by [X] has shown that...
template_cn: [X]进行的研究表明……
example_en: Research conducted by Harvard University has shown that students from low-income families benefit the most from tuition-free policies.
note: 替换: Studies consistently indicate that...

scene_detail: 需要做一个假设推理：'如果政府取消补贴，那么很可能会…'
template_en: If [条件], it is highly likely that [结果].
template_cn: 如果[条件]，那么[结果]的可能性很大。
example_en: If the government were to remove education subsidies, it is highly likely that university enrolment rates would decline significantly.

scene_detail: 先承认反方有道理，比如'诚然，传统教学确实有其优势'
template_en: Admittedly,.../Granted,...
template_cn: 诚然，……/不可否认，……
example_en: Admittedly, traditional classroom teaching does offer certain advantages, such as direct face-to-face interaction with teachers.
note: 替换: It is undeniable that... / Some may object that...

scene_detail: 让步之后需要转折反驳，指出对方的论证忽略了什么关键事实
template_en: However, this argument fails to account for the fact that...
template_cn: 然而，这一论点未能考虑到……这一事实。
example_en: However, this argument fails to account for the fact that online learning provides far greater flexibility and accessibility for students worldwide.
note: 替换: Nevertheless, I would contend that... / While this may hold true, it overlooks...

scene_detail: 承认对方的担忧有道理，但强调我方的论据更有分量、更重要
template_en: That said, this concern is largely outweighed by...
template_cn: 话虽如此，这一担忧在很大程度上被……所抵消。
example_en: That said, this concern is largely outweighed by the long-term economic benefits of having a well-educated workforce.

scene_detail: 文章结尾需要总结全文，重新强调自己的立场和两个核心理由
template_en: In conclusion, I maintain that [立场], primarily because [核心理由1] and [核心理由2].
template_cn: 总之，我坚持认为[立场]，主要因为[核心理由1]和[核心理由2]。
example_en: In conclusion, I maintain that universities should be free, primarily because this promotes social equality and drives long-term economic growth.

scene_detail: 结尾需要做最终的利弊权衡，明确表示优势远大于劣势
template_en: On balance, it seems clear that the advantages of [X] far outweigh any potential drawbacks.
template_cn: 总的来说，[X]的优势似乎明显远大于任何潜在的弊端。
example_en: On balance, it seems clear that the advantages of free university education far outweigh any potential drawbacks.

scene_detail: 结尾需要呼吁政府或个人立即采取行动来解决讨论的问题
template_en: It is therefore imperative that governments/individuals take immediate steps to...
template_cn: 因此，政府/个人必须立即采取措施来……
example_en: It is therefore imperative that governments take immediate steps to make higher education more affordable and accessible.

scene_detail: 写完一个论点后，需要再补充一个新的支持论据
template_en: Furthermore,/Moreover,/In addition to this,/What is more,
template_cn: 此外，/而且，/除此之外，/更重要的是，
example_en: Furthermore, remote working has been shown to increase employee productivity and overall job satisfaction.

scene_detail: 前面说了A的情况，现在需要引出B的相反情况来做对比
template_en: By contrast,/Conversely,/On the other hand,/Whereas...
template_cn: 相比之下，/相反，/另一方面，/然而……
example_en: By contrast, employees who work in traditional offices often spend over an hour commuting each day.

scene_detail: 前面说了一个方向，现在需要话锋一转，提出不同的看法
template_en: However,/Nevertheless,/That said,/Even so,
template_cn: 然而，/尽管如此，/话虽如此，/即便如此，
example_en: However, it is important to recognise that not all students benefit equally from free education policies.

scene_detail: 需要表达前后两句话之间的因果关系，说明原因或结果
template_en: As a consequence,/This results in/Owing to/For this reason,
template_cn: 因此，/这导致了/由于/正因如此，
example_en: As a consequence, many families are unable to afford the rising cost of higher education.

scene_detail: 需要特别强调某个重要信息，引起读者注意
template_en: Indeed,/In particular,/It is worth noting that/Notably,
template_cn: 确实，/尤其是，/值得注意的是，/特别是，
example_en: In particular, students from disadvantaged backgrounds stand to gain the most from such educational reforms.
